cx.t: Membaca query dari FROM sampai LIMIT

FROM produk                   -- 1) ambil tabel
WHERE stok > 0                -- 2) buang produk yang habis

LIMIT 3;                      -- 5) ambil tiga teratas

       SUM(stok) AS total_unit,
       SUM(harga * stok) AS nilai_persediaan,
       MIN(harga) AS termurah,
       MAX(harga) AS termahal
FROM produk
WHERE stok > 0;
